plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Water Resource Management, Intermediate Technical Certificate' program page (Major Code: 4113T), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/agriculture-department/water-resource-management/water-resource-management-intermediate-technical-certificate . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Intermediate Technical Certificate (page title; the program page lists BTC and ITC awards - the ITC is the flagship certificate modeled here). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 30, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 30'); semester tables print 15/15 and sum exactly. Choice slots: 'COMM GE OR ENGL 101' (3 cr - COMM GE placeholder or the named ENGL 101 course); PROG ELEC 3 + 9 = 12 hours (student choice: any AGRI, AQUA, BIOL, CHEM, MATH, or WATR course, or the listed GEOL courses - 0-credit lab courses accompany their lecture courses per the catalog); MATH GE / SOCS GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
